title: Clean code, clean test workshop, day 1
summary: A workshop I delivered for Philips software teams.

ratings.label: Level of engagement with the audience

feedback.themes: Participants most often valued hands-on demos, the interaction and clear explanations. Suggestions centered on more hands-on practice and more time or a follow-up session.
quotes: Practical session , Brief of the concepts , Q & A.
The facilitators were well prepared and had a clear agenda on the content to be present. Hence the workshop was very interesting from start to the end.
